posts.text: Founders wrapping Codex to ship their own coding tool: OpenAI's own SDK and app-server docs bless custom clients, managed ChatGPT login, and Plus/Pro plan states. That's an intended integration path, not a gray-area hack. The unresolved risk is scraping the Codex TUI directly, since OpenAI never squares that against its consumer anti-extraction clause. App-server is the defensible route.
